content:
morgan: Kickoff for launch week microexperiment. Aim: convert signups -> first successful request. Tactics: 3 social posts, Product demo clip, 45s benchmark mini for X, LinkedIn long read, webinar Fri. Experiment = instant vs gated credits + prompt-template exposure timing.

kai: Love the scope. Two variants: INSTANT = 750 credits on signup; GATED = 250 credits on confirm + 1000 on first successful request. Control = no credit. We will randomize 40/40/20.

ivy: Important: add credit decay policy so credits expire in 14 days to avoid long-term liability. Also add a max-credit cap per org = 5000.

harper: Webinar funnel idea: register -> confirm -> add to calendar -> 1h reminder -> live. Attendees get 1200 + promptpack; no-shows get 300 if they watch recording within 72h. Route high-fit leads (intent_score >= 0.7 OR company_size >= 50) to SDR via /hooks/sdr-bucket.

morgan: For routing, prefer intent_score over heuristics. Kai can you add intent_score to the signup payload?

kai: Yes. We'll send payload:

```
POST /hooks/sdr-bucket
{
  user_id: id,
  intent_score: analytics.intentScore(user),
  company_size: traits.company_size
}
```

Ops: ensure idempotency by including request_id.

ivy: Promptpack exposure: INSTANT gets templates in welcome email; GATED only after first successful request. Track prompts_opened and prompts_used. Also include short how-to GIF in email to lower friction.

harper: Creative asks: 3 caption hooks for X, 1 long LI piece for the benchmark story, and a 45s voice-over script highlighting cost/latency drop with batching+cache. Keep the voice-over <80 words.

morgan: Analytics: events = launch_signup, launch_confirm, credit_granted, first_success, webinar_attend, promptpack_sent. Primary metric = first_success @ 7d. Secondary = tokens_used_per_activation and retention @14d. Tag events with variant.

kai: Segment rule pseudocode:

```
if (is_new && !email_blocklist.includes(email)) {
  assignVariant(user.id)
  identify(user.id, {launch_variant: variant})
  if (variant === 'INSTANT') post('/hooks/credit', {user_id, amount:750, req_id})
}
```

Make hooks idempotent.

ops-bot: Deployed staging hooks: /hooks/credit-launch-v3, /hooks/sdr-bucket, /hooks/promptpack-deliver. Staging run id: run_8801. Logs: https://ops.internal/tests/run_8801 :white_check_mark:

ivy: Also add UTM params for each channel: utm_campaign=launch_sprout&utm_variant={variant}&utm_channel={channel}. Shortlinks via bit.ly preferred.

harper: Product Hunt note: need a concise benchmark paragraph and a one-liner "why it matters". Call out concrete numbers (e.g., cost per prompt cut by 3x). Avoid jargon.

morgan: Action items: kai -> implement variant assign + idempotent hooks; ivy -> email copy + promptpack + credit expiry wording; harper -> creative + PH copy + webinar survey; ops-bot -> confirm prod hooks and provide logs. Check-in tomorrow 9:30am PT. :rocket:

kai: 👍 will add test harness and share test IDs before EOD.
